title: logikbench tpu
description: Weight-stationary 8x8 systolic matrix-multiply tile (N=8, 8-bit signed operands, 32-bit accumulators) from zeroasiccorp/logikbench (commit e8c7c43, MIT). The unmodified upstream RTL is the starting point.
flow: Yosys synthesis and OpenROAD static timing analysis on ASAP7. The gate-level netlist is re-simulated against the testbench on every evaluation; the testbench compares the design cycle by cycle with a trace recorded from the upstream RTL.

notes.glm-5.2: Default effort, pinned to Z.AI. Through OpenRouter a request without an effort setting behaves like thinking off: the default, high and off rows all produce 1k to 2k output tokens per step, and their results are within noise of each other. The high-effort runs are recorded but held back from the table.
notes.kimi-k3-high: RTLSCOUT_REASONING_EFFORT=high (seed runs launched 2026-07-26). The old run directories do not record the effort; the split by launch date comes from the campaign notes.
notes.nemotron-3-ultra: 550B-A55B. One seed run ended above the starting point: it edited the design before measuring the unmodified one.
notes.glm-5.2-nothink: RTLSCOUT_REASONING_EFFORT=off, pinned to Z.AI: zero reasoning tokens in every reply.
notes.glm-5.2-high: RTLSCOUT_REASONING_EFFORT=high, pinned to Z.AI. Held back from the table: the setting leaves GLM 5.2's reasoning volume unchanged (1k to 2k output tokens per step, as at default), see the GLM 5.2 note.
notes.glm-5.3-flash: Default effort, which Z.AI documents as max for this model; 13k to 18k output tokens per step, reasoning included. Pinned to Z.AI.
notes.glm-5.3-flash-high: RTLSCOUT_REASONING_EFFORT=high, one level below Z.AI's default max for this model: 2k to 6k output tokens per step against 13k to 18k for the default row. Pinned to Z.AI.
notes.deepseek-v4.1-flash: Default effort, which DeepSeek documents as high. Pinned to the CoreWeave endpoint (fp8).
notes.mimo-v2.6-flash: Default: thinking on (a toggle at Xiaomi). Pinned to Xiaomi's endpoint (fp8).

footnotes: Rows labelled as measured before the current suite are earlier data (pre-v1 seed runs from July 2026 with an unpackaged rtlscout, or suite-v1 runs from October 2026 without the provider pin and completion cap). Each is replaced when reruns of that entry under the current suite are published.

The seed runs were checked against the original 830-cycle vector file. suite-v1 ships a 6,782-cycle file whose first 830 cycles are identical. Their best designs were re-evaluated with rtlscout 0.2.0 against the 6,782-cycle file on 2026-10-06: all twelve pass every check and reproduce the recorded cost.
The seed runs were launched six at a time (three Verilog and three Spire HDL runs of one model per campaign), so their wall-clock times include that load.
All entries were called through OpenRouter without prompt caching, so every step pays for its full input.

Before 2026-10-12 the task text cited the starting point as `context/starting_point.v`; the file is `starting_point.v` in the agent's workspace, so every run of that period lost one step to a failed read. Corrected on 2026-10-12; the task is otherwise unchanged.
